title: A real corpus, and one way to get candles
note: One loader: scripts/research/m20_fleet_exit_sweep.py::resolve_data (the (symbol,timeframe)->file mapping) + scripts/ops/backtest_data_source.py::resolve_or_refuse (the policy every harness's CLI calls), documented in docs/reference/backtest-data-loading.md. 16 of the 17 previously-unwired harnesses (the 2 already fixed + 14 of the 15 in BL-20260912) now go through it; symbol_data_binding_census.py reports 1 (scripts/ml/build_calibration_corpus.py), DEFERRED to a follow-up because that path sits outside check_pr_landing.py's TIER1_SURFACE (scripts/ml/** is not on it) and widening that allowlist is itself LANDING_MACHINERY (R12) -- doing it inside this self-land PR would force a human hold. The census guard is therefore NOT yet gated in run_guards.py (would fail CI at 1). --data made mandatory: a bare invocation (no --symbol, no --data) now REFUSES rather than reaching the fixture by default (resolve_or_refuse's allow_implicit_default, default False); the fixture stays, reachable only explicitly. docs/reference/corpus-manifest.json (moved there from data/ -- also a TIER1_SURFACE constraint, data/** is not on it) covers 46/47 rostered (symbol,timeframe) pairs with stated rows/start/end/source (SPLG_1d is an honest, disclosed gap -- Yahoo returns 'possibly delisted' for that one ticker specifically); CSVs are fetched on demand (scripts/ops/fetch_backtest_corpus.py, orchestrating the existing scripts/ops/fetch_backtest_candles.py) rather than committed, per the repo's existing .gitignore policy against committing regenerable data/*.csv. New guard scripts/ci/check_corpus_row_floor.py fails a manifest row (or a committed candle file) below 500 rows, with self-test positive/negative controls; gated in run_guards.py. No scheduled workflow invocation needed changing (all already pass --symbol/--data); one test (tests/test_risk_grid_sweep.py) updated to keep exercising its own target refusal now that data-source resolution runs first.
